name: Realm Invader
source:
In this game, you follow a young [s]soulless shell for you to self-insert into[/s] man who lives in a world very similar to yours. Recently, he's been riddled with several mysterious ailments, including headaches, goosebumps, and an inexplicable sense of dread.

These symptoms were a warning, this man finds himself in the middle of a cataclysmic event, at least, it would seem so. Where cataclysms will typically lead to the destruction of a world, this one has led to a birth. The nature of his world has shifted around him. There are new species, an altered society, and magic.

He needs to learn about his new circumstances and what he can do with his new magical abilities. This man will slowly come to realize why he was sent to this world and walks a journey to unravel the mystery of his existence.

...
...
...
...
Oh, yeah, and he fucks a bunch of people on the way.

[From [url=https://realminvader.itch.io/realm-invader]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个游戏中，你跟随一个年轻的[s]没有灵魂的外壳，让你自我插入到生活在与你非常相似的世界中的[/s]男人中。最近，他患有多种神秘的疾病，包括头痛、起鸡皮疙瘩和莫名的恐惧感。

这些症状是一个警告，这个人发现自己正处于一场灾难性事件之中，至少看起来是这样。灾难通常会导致世界的毁灭，而这次却带来了诞生。他周围世界的本质已经发生了变化。这里有新的物种、改变的社会和魔法。

他需要了解他的新环境以及他可以用他的新魔法能力做什么。这个男人会慢慢明白自己为何被送到这个世界，并踏上解开自己存在之谜的旅程。

…
…
…
…
哦，是的，他在路上和一群人上床了。

[来自[url=https://realminvader.itch.io/realm-invader]Itch.io[/url]]
